sections.title: Explanation
sections.content: Hungarian usually marks plural nouns with -k. The form of the noun may change before the suffix.

items.spanish: A székek az ablakok mellett vannak.
items.english: The chairs are next to the windows.

sections.content: Compare székek and ablakok: both are simply plural, but szék takes the front-vowel link -ek while ablak takes the back-vowel link -ok. Say the word out loud — the vowel harmony is usually obvious once you're listening for it, so you rarely have to memorize which linking vowel a noun takes.
